author: Top Gear

In this video Top Gear reviews the new Lamborghini Temerario and Porsche 911 Turbo S. They’re not out-and-out rivals, but both are 4WD, newly electrified and aimed at regular daily use, so is a top-end sports car or entry-level supercar better?
